reviewer_role: Peer source review; reviewer did not author this builder and did not invoke it or any supplied proof/guard/generator.
scope: Full268-line dynamic builder, its complete-record gates, actual-provider closure verification, exact source/audit mapping, terminal history preservation and standalone content-addressed archive design; focused schema samples from existing v3/v4 reused records. No complete coverage outcome is asserted.
reviewed_properties: All requested manifest/guard/complete-batch/independent-review identities are explicit pins; total/probe/caller counts derive from the chosen manifest, not stale v3 assumptions.

Every selected module requires actual source+audit PASS, raw audit agreement, zero warnings, default limits, source object captured before audit, current input hashes and exact imported provider closure.
The final Sites object must use every selected ancestor object. Independent review must enumerate precisely the complete selected record set and assert current provider/pre-audit checks.
Only three exact historical pilot records lack separate preparation. Other selected units require successful matching prepare-only metadata.

Both history roots are captured as exact UTF8 content with path aliases; compiled objects/symlinks are excluded explicitly. Failed runs and stopped batches remain historical; missing failed records or live status are rejected.
Standalone history blobs reuse already-mapped identical content by hash; all aliases roundtrip to exact bytes. Full original builder and versioned scripts are within the captured production root.
The output must be external and absent. Existing maintained targets must be byte-identical; the builder itself writes only scratch mapping files.
All selected inputs and all staged bytes are rehashed after staging. No checker, compiler, dependency build, version query, generator or simulator is invoked.
limits: Source-only review cannot establish eventual final record identities, complete census, successful runtime packaging or current hashes at future invocation. Root must supply actual final parent and review pins and inspect the produced map.
